pins.title: Icy trail? Grip before you slip.
pins.sub: Chain cleats that fit over your boots.
pins.pinTitle: Chain ice cleats for hiking boots: grip on icy trails, frozen boardwalks and packed snow
pins.description: Stainless steel chain ice cleats that stretch over your hiking boots or winter shoes for icy trailheads, frozen boardwalks and packed-snow trails. One pair with a storage bag, fits about US women's 4 to US men's 11 (EU 34-45). Made for everyday winter trails, not steep ice: that needs crampons.

pins.title: A gift for short winter days
pins.sub: Headlamp, neck gaiter and winter guide.
pins.pinTitle: Winter hiking gift set: motion-sensor headlamp, neck gaiter and printable winter hiking guide
pins.description: A gift for someone who keeps hiking when the days get short: a rechargeable USB-C motion-sensor headlamp, a seamless neck gaiter in the color you pick and our 22-page Winter Hiking Guide PDF. $29.99 as a set instead of $34.97 separately. Gear ships in 6-13 business days, so order early for the holidays.

pins.title: Cold platform, warm feet.
pins.sub: Merino socks for the daily commute.
pins.pinTitle: Warm merino wool socks for winter commutes: cold train platforms, office days and city walks
pins.description: Waiting on a cold platform or walking to the office in winter: our cushioned merino wool crew socks (80% merino) keep feet warm, stay comfortable when damp and resist odor through a long day. Four colors, for work, travel and weekend walks.

pins.title: For the one who is always cold
pins.pinTitle: Merino wool socks gift for someone who is always cold: warm crew socks for home, work and walks
pins.description: A small gift that gets worn all winter: cushioned merino wool crew socks (80% merino) for cold floors at home, the office, dog walks and the trail. Four colors. Socks ship in 6-13 business days, so order early for the holidays.

pins.title: Hiking at 20°F? Layer like this.
pins.sub: Base, fleece, shell, a puffy for stops.
pins.pinTitle: What to wear hiking in 20 degree weather: base layer, fleece, windproof shell and a puffy for stops
pins.description: What to wear hiking at 20°F (-7°C): a midweight wool or synthetic base layer, a fleece, a windproof hooded shell, insulated or softshell pants, a warm hat, a balaclava or neck gaiter, gloves plus mittens and wool socks. Carry a puffy for every stop and skip cotton.

pins.title: Bears asleep all winter? Not always.
pins.sub: What to do if you meet one.
pins.pinTitle: What to do if you see a bear while hiking in winter: stay calm, talk, never run, back away slowly
pins.description: Not every bear sleeps all winter: some den late, wake on warm days or come out early. If you meet one on a winter hike, stay calm, talk in a calm voice, pick up small children, never run and back away slowly. What park rangers say about bears in the cold months.

pins.title: Poles in hand, dog on your hip.
pins.sub: A hands-free leash for trail days.
pins.pinTitle: Hands-free dog leash for hiking: waist belt and double bungee so your hands stay free for poles
pins.description: Hike with your dog and keep both hands for trekking poles, a gate or a steep step. An adjustable waist belt (27.5-50.4 in / 70-128 cm) with a reflective double-bungee leash that softens sudden pulls, plus a short handle for close control. Best for dogs that already walk well on a leash.

pins.title: Big hike next year? Start training now.
pins.pinTitle: 8-week hiking training plan for beginners, printable: no gym, strength moves and weekly hikes
pins.description: Getting ready for a park trip, a first 10-miler or a summit? A printable 8-week plan with five short sessions a week: walks, hikes and simple strength moves like step-ups and calf raises, with pack weight in lb and kg and distances in miles and km. Instant PDF.

pins.title: Glacier and the Canadian Rockies, one trip
pins.sub: Plans for Glacier, Banff and Jasper.
pins.board: Best Day Hikes in US National Parks
pins.pinTitle: Glacier National Park and Banff Jasper trip planner printable: Canadian Rockies road trip itinerary
pins.description: Planning Glacier National Park and the Canadian Rockies in one road trip? Two printable trip planning guides in one bundle, Glacier and Banff & Jasper, with itineraries and day hikes for a Montana to Alberta trip. Instant PDF download.

pins.title: Fog rolling in? Know what to do.
pins.pinTitle: Hiking safety guide printable: what to do if you get lost, the weather turns or daylight runs out
pins.description: Ten short chapters on what really goes wrong on ordinary hikes and what to do: getting lost, weather turning, cold and hypothermia signs, heat, injuries, running out of daylight, wildlife and calling for help, plus a one-page emergency reference. Printable PDF and a phone edition.
